title: P1 Postmortem (notes): KV cache fragmentation causes latency spikes
body:
Incident date: 2026-02-22
Severity: P1

Summary
- After enabling a new continuous batching setting for long contexts, p95 latency regressed for some models. GPU utilization looked fine, but memory allocator time increased.

Impact
- Hosted API: p95 +35% for llama-family long-context routes in us-east for ~52 minutes.
- No customer-visible errors, but SLO burn.

Root cause (suspected)
- KV cache pages were being allocated/freed with poor locality under mixed sequence lengths. Fragmentation increased and allocator began spending time coalescing pages.

Follow-up action items (count these)
1) Add runtime metric for KV cache fragmentation and allocator coalescing time. Owner team: Eng Serving Runtime.
2) Implement KV cache defragmentation strategy for mixed-length workloads (or switch to pooled allocator). Owner team: Eng Serving Runtime.
3) Add perf-canary test case for mixed seq length distribution to catch fragmentation regressions. Owner team: Eng Serving Runtime.
4) Add SRE alert on sustained allocator_coalesce_ms > threshold per model route. Owner team: Eng SRE.

Open questions
- Whether defrag is required or if a different page size is enough.
